style: Clean contemporary flat vector illustration in deep slate (#15212b), candy red (#ef3e5b) and white, smooth rounded shapes, subtle road-line motifs, no text.

subjects.mecanique-generale: An open car engine bay seen from above with a plain smooth engine cover (no emblem, no badge); a hand-held diagnostic scanner lies on the fender, plugged in by its cable, a combination wrench beside it. No hands, no people.

hero: A modern neighbourhood repair shop interior: a car on a lift, a red rolling tool chest, a tire rack, wide windows showing a blurred evening street with trees. Flat vector, DARK slate overall, candy-red highlights, white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no numbers.
